When the sun, with cheerful beams
When the sun, with cheerful beams,
And a rainbow meets the eye:
This bright arch is never seen.
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Newton printed the hymn under Genesis 9:14. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
Whenever I form clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds, GENESIS 9:14 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ GENESIS 9
